## Install
1. Download the zip for your PC below: **`win-x64`** for most PCs, **`win-arm64`** for ARM PCs (for example Snapdragon).
2. Extract it to a folder and run `Adobe Camera Profiles Unlocker.exe`. No installer and no .NET download needed.
3. The app is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run: select **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Requires Windows 10 version 1809 or later and Adobe Camera Raw (comes with Lightroom Classic and Photoshop). Restart Lightroom or Photoshop after installing camera profiles.
